description: Land Acquisition - Kotawella, Rambukkana D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of multiple land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land lots, their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which includes "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
